jobs.title: Full Stack Java Developer
jobs.description:
Project description
VR-124185
Our Client is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Their purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
Team is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Java developer. Our group is focused on bringing a new level of efficiency, transparency and openness to the trading process by building a collaborative community of investors, brokers, technology firms and content providers.
Through our modular, end-to-end trade management platform, users can: execute everything from simple single stock trades to complex strategies across markets and time zones and manage their risk throughout the trade lifecycle; access our growing network of execution brokers to route Equities, Futures or Options orders globally, as well as dozens of integrated prime and clearing brokers through our growing suite of middle office tools; and collaborate with our broker and vendor partners, who are able to efficiently plug into our platform to reach our community.
This role involves maintenance and enhancement of existing backend and web-based applications, and contributing to the evolution of our trading platform and web user interfaces.
Responsibilities
Contributes to design, development, and implementation of backend services and web applications.
Writes clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established engineering practices.
Participates in technical design discussions and collaborates with senior engineers and architects.
Works closely with frontend developers to integrate backend services with UI components.
Supports troubleshooting, debugging, and performance optimization of applications.
Breaks down user stories into technical tasks and delivers within agreed timelines.
Collaborates effectively in Agile teams with product owners, QA, and other developers.
Maintains and improves existing systems while ensuring stability and reliability.
Builds positive relationships within the team and contributes to a collaborative environment.
Communicates technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Continuously develops technical expertise and stays up to date with modern technologies and frameworks.
Skills
Must have
Strong Java fundamentals (Java 21 preferred) including core concepts (collections, concurrency, memory management).
Solid experience with Spring Framework (Spring 4+) and Spring Boot 3.x.
Experience building and consuming REST APIs.
Good knowledge of React (version 17) and integration with backend services.
Strong understanding of web application architecture and client-server communication.
Experience with SQL and relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL).
Proficiency with version control (Git) and build tools (Maven/Gradle).
Strong focus on clean code, unit testing, and code reviews.
Familiar with Agile development practices.
Comfortable working in Linux/Unix environments.
5-8+ years of software engineering experience.
Experience with trading platforms is preferred; however, candidates with broader financial services systems experience will also be considered.
Nice to have
Experience with JSF / JSP applications and legacy UI technologies.
Familiarity with modern frontend practices and component-based architectures.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and testing practices.
Exposure to Docker / containerization.
Basic understanding of distributed systems.
Familiarity with Spring ecosystem tooling.
Knowledge of financial systems or trading platforms is a plus.
BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent software engineering qualification.

jobs.title: Full-stack Technical Lead (Java+React)
jobs.description:
N-iX is a global software development service company that helps businesses across the globe create next-generation software products. Founded in 2002, we unite 2,400+ tech-savvy professionals across 40+ countries, working on impactful projects for industry leaders and Fortune 500 companies. Our expertise spans cloud, data, AI/ML, embedded software, IoT, and more, driving digital transformation across finance, manufacturing, telecom, healthcare, and other industries. Join N-iX and become part of a team where your ideas make a real impact.
Nowadays, finding a long-term job with an interesting project can feel like a real challenge.
But hey — if you're an experienced
Technical Lead / Full Stack Engineer (Java + React)
, look no further!
Yes, it's real. You're not dreaming. Miracles do exist!
When it comes to our customer – a strategic partner of ours in the integrated Shipping Services. They have set themselves apart as an independent carrier with a fresh, unique approach. Their strategy as a global niche carrier offers distinctive advantages to customers worldwide. We have created a smart, efficient network that ensures stable, reliable services; and we have made it our mission to focus on the needs of our customers, which stand at the heart of all our decisions. The main idea of our product operates in select trades, where it has a competitive advantage and where it can provide superior service. We maintain a flexible partnership approach with other major carriers, and our new line structure is a much-needed alternative to customers concerned about the current alliance-dominated market.
Responsibilities:
Guide, mentor, and foster the growth of full-stack engineers within the team, championing engineering excellence and XP practices.
Lead the architectural design and technical direction of innovative full-stack applications, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with business goals.
Establish and champion high standards of code quality, testing (TDD/BDD), CI/CD pipelines, and robust DevOps practices.
Act as a key technical point of contact, collaborating closely with product owners and stakeholders to translate complex requirements into actionable technical strategies.
Direct full-stack development of innovative applications, remaining actively involved in writing code and remote pairing.
Own the entire development cycle, including design, architecture, development, testing, and DevOps deployment.
Foster a highly collaborative Extreme Programming (XP) environment featuring remote pairing and rapid feedback loops.
Requirements:
BS degree
in Computer Science or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience
in technical leadership is a must.
6+ years
of full-stack development experience.
6+ years
of experience in the following technologies: Java, Spring.
Proven experience with Functional Programming and Java Streams.

of experience in front-end development with React.
Experience with developing a reactive UI (Reactive JS).
2+ years
of experience in TDD/BDD development in the following frameworks: JUnit, Jasmine, Mockito, Protractor/Selenium.
2+ years
of experience in microservices-based architecture and tools (Spring Boot/Cloud).
AI experience
Experience in DevOps development and Jenkins (must).
Experience in development in Kotlin – an advantage.
Experience in designing, developing, and deploying cloud/hybrid-based solutions.
Experience in developing and deploying in Container-based environments (Kubernetes, Cloud Foundry).
Deep familiarity with the following design concepts: microservices, service discovery, circuit breakers.
Strong leadership abilities
with the capacity to appropriately prioritize, plan, and delegate complex work in a rapidly changing environment.
Versatility and capability to switch easily between different tasks and technologies.
Experience in assessing a broad range of information solutions and products.
Strong critical thinker with an exceptional problem-solving aptitude.
Excellent English
skills - both verbal and written.
